{{More citations needed|date=July 2023}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{use mdy dates|date=April 2022}} {{Infobox television season | bgcolor = #4D2712 | image = DancingSeason16.jpg | caption = Promotional poster | module1 = {{Infobox reality competition season | host = {{Plainlist| * [[Tom Bergeron]] * [[Brooke Burke Charvet]] }} | judges = {{Plainlist| * [[Carrie Ann Inaba]] * [[Len Goodman]] * [[Bruno Tonioli]] }} | celebrity_winner = [[Kellie Pickler]] | professional_winner = [[Derek Hough]] }} | num_episodes = 20 | network = [[American Broadcasting Company|ABC]] | first_aired = {{start date|2013|3|18}} | last_aired = {{end date|2013|5|21}} }} '''Season sixteen''' of ''[[Dancing with the Stars (American TV series)|Dancing with the Stars]]'' premiered on March 18, 2013, on the [[American Broadcasting Company|ABC]] network. Country music singer and ''[[American Idol]]'' finalist [[Kellie Pickler]] and [[Derek Hough]] were crowned the champions, while [[The Walt Disney Company|Disney Channel]] star [[Zendaya]] and {{sortname|Valentin|Chmerkovskiy}} finished in second place, and [[Baltimore Ravens]] wide receiver [[Jacoby Jones]] and [[Karina Smirnoff]] finished third. ==Cast== ===Couples=== This season featured twelve celebrity contestants. Eleven celebrities and their professional partners were announced on February 26, 2013, on ''[[Good Morning America]]'', with [[Jacoby Jones]]' participation having been confirmed two days earlier during a network promo that aired during the [[85th Academy Awards|85th Oscars]]. Two weeks following the cast announcement, [[Sean Lowe (television personality)|Sean Lowe]] as revealed as the twelfth contestant. [[Lindsay Arnold]], a contestant from [[So You Think You Can Dance (American season 9)|season nine]] of ''[[So You Think You Can Dance (United States)|So You Think You Can Dance]],'' was introduced as a new professional along with [[Sharna Burgess]], who had been a member of the dance troupe. [[Gleb Savchenko]], who had recently participated as a professional on [[Dancing with the Stars (Australian season 12)|season twelve]] of the [[Dancing with the Stars (Australian TV series)|Australian ''Dancing with the Stars'']], was also announced as a new professional.
